title: OpenAI Agents SDK (Python)
summary: An Agent with function tools, needs_approval on the refund, a saved RunState that resumes when the person answers, turn and token limits, OpenTelemetry. The SDK's own trace upload to OpenAI is off.
verified: RUN: the scaffold's 12 tests and its gold set (11 of 11) ran here against the offline stub with openai-agents 0.25.0, including the approval interruption, a declined refund and a resume from saved state; the project audit reads READY. Not run against a live model here.
stack_line: An OpenAI Agents SDK agent in Python (openai-agents 0.25).
run_cmd: uv run -m agent.app "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
live: Set OPENAI_API_KEY (OPENAI_BASE_URL for a compatible gateway) and AGENT_MODE=live. AGENT_MODEL picks the model.
next: Replace the two tool bodies in agent/tools.py with calls to your systems.
Store result["state"] while a refund waits (it holds the conversation: treat it like one) and call resume() when the person answers.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: Live runs default to an open-weight model on your own machine (qwen3:8b on Ollama, Apache-2.0); set AGENT_MODEL to an OpenAI model to use OpenAI.

api.none: a command-line agent today; the 1.1 solution composer serves it over HTTP with approvals in the API

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them
